description: Two fictional reports about the same holding within one day that point in opposite directions. Analyzing the second after the first must yield reassess_assumptions and read_primary_source citing BOTH articles.

articles.title: ACME raises full-year guidance after record orders
articles.summary: Fictional teaching fixture. ACME says orders increased in the quarter and lifted its outlook.

articles.title: ACME cuts full-year outlook as orders decline
articles.summary: Fictional teaching fixture. A competing report says ACME expects weaker demand next quarter.
